title: 2020 Upper Deck Disney Lion King A Lion's Pride Simba Pumbaa Timon & #LP-9
descriptionText: This 2020 Upper Deck Disney Lion King A Lion's Pride trading card features Simba, Pumbaa, and Timon. The card is an original and comes from the manufacturer Upper Deck. It is a single-insert card with the card number LP-9. The card is part of the Non-Sports category and is perfect for collectors who are looking for a unique addition to their collection. The card is not graded and is an excellent choice for anyone who loves Disney and Lion King.
